short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: The factory got a power factor penalty!
short_scenes.narration: Volt's factory got a penalty from the electricity board for low power factor.
With the current lagging, some energy just sloshes back and forth. The cables carry current that does no work.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: A parallel capacitor cut the current from four point six to two point seven six amperes for the same power.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: Watch the full video: AC power & power factor!
short_scenes.narration: For the detailed explanation, watch the full video on our channel. It's part of our complete Network Theory course.
